reason: This plugin is primarily a web user interface utility that lets users load and inspect 3D models in DeepSeek Harness, then translate those models into a standardized, LLM-readable JSON format and pass it into chat context. Evidence in the repository description, README feature list, and DSH manifest shows both a host tool (`read_3d_model`) and a client overlay panel workflow, with supported formats explicitly including OBJ/STL/STEP and optional immediate send/export paths. The classification focuses on visualization and model handling rather than automation or external service orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面中提供 3D 模型查看与转换能力，支持加载 OBJ/STL/STEP 模型、在悬浮面板交互预览，并将结果转换为标准化 JSON 以便发送到对话上下文。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a DeepSeek Harness web panel for viewing OBJ/STL/STEP models, lets users interact with them in 3D, and converts models into a standardized JSON format that can be inserted into chat context.

capabilities: Render 3D models in a web floating panel with interactive controls
Convert parsed model data to a standardized JSON schema with analytic fields
Append generated model context to conversation input or enqueue immediate send
Load STEP parser runtime via browser-side dependency during rendering

reasons.code: Host-side `read_3d_model` tool is advertised to parse OBJ/STL/STEP inputs into standardized JSON for LLM use.
Client side exposes an interactive web overlay panel for rotating, panning, zooming, material, lighting, and section view of models.
STEP handling relies on a browser-loaded WASM path (occt-import-js) and the README documents that source for wasm can be customized.
Package manifest declares DSH bundle/client plugin wiring and web platform injection, confirming execution as a web extension.
